controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:36:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:36:22.000Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.6" AND destination.ip == "172.18.0.12"
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_ts = MIN(@timestamp), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY zeek.ssh.client, zeek.ssh.server, zeek.ssh.auth.success
| SORT count DESC
